_comment: One entry per coding agent whose login Nightshift hands to sandboxes. file: where the agent keeps its login, relative to $HOME. access: jq path of the access token in that file. filter: jq building the sandbox copy from the login ($ph is the placeholder for secret, $far a far-future timestamp). It must construct the result from the fields it keeps, never copy the rest of the file: a login file can hold other credentials, such as Claude Code's MCP server tokens. hosts: the API hosts that must swap that secret (checked against k8s/egress.yaml). pool: the warm pool kept only while this login exists. exercise: command that makes the agent refresh an expiring token. cpa: how to rebuild this login file from a CLIProxyAPI credential (type is its provider name, build a jq program over the credential), so a CLIProxyAPI login can stand in for logging in with the CLI itself.

cpa.build: {claudeAiOauth: {accessToken: .access_token, refreshToken: .refresh_token, expiresAt: 1999999999999, scopes: ["user:file_upload","user:inference","user:mcp_servers","user:plugins","user:privacy_consents:write","user:profile","user:sessions:claude_code"], subscriptionType: "pro", rateLimitTier: "default_claude_ai", accountUuid: .account_uuid, organizationUuid: .organization_uuid}}

providers.filter: {auth_mode: .auth_mode, OPENAI_API_KEY: null, tokens: (.tokens | .access_token = $ph | .refresh_token = "nightshift:secret:CODEX_REFRESH_TOKEN_UNUSABLE" | if .account_id then .account_id = "nightshift:secret:CODEX_ACCOUNT_ID" else . end), last_refresh: $far}

cpa.build: {auth_mode: "chatgpt", OPENAI_API_KEY: null, tokens: {id_token: .id_token, access_token: .access_token, refresh_token: .refresh_token, account_id: .account_id}, last_refresh: .last_refresh}
{token: {access_token: .access_token, token_type: "Bearer", refresh_token: .refresh_token, expiry: .expired, expires_in: .expires_in}, auth_method: "consumer", id_token_email: .email}
